about_the_game:
Run, fight or flee! In Powder Runners: Maze Quest, you alone or with your team will face dangerous mazes against opponents and traps. Grab weapons to face enemies, collect healing items to survive and make quick decisions: is it worth engaging in combat or is it better to simply run? And get ahead!

Each match is a battle of strategy, speed and courage. Do you have what it takes to come out on top and achieve glory?

Play alone or call your friends.

Powder Runners: Maze Quest is an action, adventure and strategy game where every second counts! Enter treacherous mazes full of traps and enemies, where the goal is simple: be the first to reach the Magic Portal and Win! But be careful – other players are also after victory, and they won't make your journey easy!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: DirectX 11 or 12-compatible graphics card For best results, high-end hardware is recommended. For example, to take advantage of Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Lumen, an NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD VEGA 64 graphics card or higher is recommended.

short_description: Call your friends and take on this epic challenge, play as a team or alone, to prove that you are the best! But remember: only the fastest will achieve glory. Get ready for chaos, lots of fun and mysteries – the maze awaits you!
supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese
